title: Edge Valley Bigfoot Society
author: NegSec
description:
A somewhat more intelligent than usual Bigfoot is captured by a group of Bigfoot hunters in a small Pacific Northwestern town. Can he escape their facility? Well, it's up to you to decide that. Comes with 6 endings.

(This game is my first finished parser game, so it might be a little rough around the edges, so to speak. I hope you enjoy it.)
